wiki.title: Patrick Ahrens
wiki.extract: Patrick James Ahrens (born September 12, 1989) is an American politician who is a member of the California State Assembly for the 26th district since 2024. A Democrat, he served on the Foothill–De Anza Community College District Board of Trustees and as a district director for his predecessor, Evan Low.
